thread:
nora: rolled wavelet-prefetch + latency-hold throttler canary to 9 nodes at 14:02. headline: p50 -13%, p95 -19%, p99 -23%; token-cost down ~14%. :tada:

felix: nice. which traces / evals?

stats-bot: run=run_20240810_1402_wavelet_canary, traces=[chat_peak, chat_steady, embed_mixed], throughput:+8%, kvcache_hit:+7% for short prefixes; report: https://perf/reports/run_20240810_1402_wavelet_canary

ida: what are the core changes?

nora: short: wavelet-prefetch looks for repeating short-prefix patterns using a rolling wavelet score to pre-warm KV and reduce cold misses; latency-hold throttler holds tiny windows (~40ms) when queue variance spikes to prevent giant mismatched packs. config snippet: 
```
prefetch:
  strategy: wavelet
  lookback_ms: 160
  min_score: 0.58
throttle:
  mode: latency-hold
  hold_ms: 40
  disable_threshold_ms: 120
```

felix: multiplex/h2 and streaming tails?

nora: multiplex p99 improved ~15ms; streaming p95 tightened by ~10ms. no regressions on our eval prompts. very long sequences (>3500 tokens) fall back to legacy path.

opsbot: deploy: canary:eng-runtime/wavelet-prefetch-v1 -> nodes:9 -> status: success -> ts=1759991234

nora: staggered: +40% capacity in 10h, full flip within 36h if no anomalies. canary oncall pinned for 24h post-flip. added enterprise-tenant smoke to gating runs.
